title: Build a room and measure its RT60
brief: Build a synthetic room impulse response, measure its Schroeder decay curve, and read the reverberation time from the curve's slope.
hints: The envelope that falls by a factor of 1000 in rt60 seconds is np.exp(-np.log(1000.0) * t / rt60).
The energy still to come is a reversed cumulative sum: np.cumsum((h ** 2)[::-1])[::-1].
Energy is a squared quantity, so convert it to decibels with 10 * np.log10, not 20.
Fit np.polyfit(t, decay, 1) against time in seconds, not against sample index, then extrapolate with -60 / slope.
